focus: ApplyBirthOutcome prefix/postfix/finalizer for humanlike inheritance: are all birth paths covered (normal, doctor carry, growth vat, stillborn), any nesting with the existing BirthContext, and does inheriting after spawn (carried case) refresh name/visuals
diffSource: since build 42 (2026-10-06T17:59:24Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: BirthContext finalizers clear unconditionally, so the context is not re-entrant
findings.detail: Patch_PregnancyUtility_ApplyBirthOutcome.Finalizer (and the existing DoBirthSpawn/Hatch finalizers) call BirthContext.Clear() regardless of what was active on entry. No vanilla path nests these calls: DoBirthSpawn and CompHatcher.Hatch never reach ApplyBirthOutcome, and ApplyBirthOutcome's only callers are LaborPushing, the ChildBirth ritual, the growth vat and a dev tool. But a mod that calls ApplyBirthOutcome from inside an animal birth or hatch would have the outer context wiped before its own TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn. Saving the previous state in __state in the Prefix and restoring it in the Finalizer would make it safe. No corpus mod patches these targets, so there is no precedent either way.

findings.title: Carried-case inheritance runs after the birth letter and Notify_PawnBorn
findings.detail: In the doctor-carry branch the postfix applies traits only after ApplyBirthOutcome has sent the ChoiceLetter_BabyBirth and called Find.QuestManager.Notify_PawnBorn. The letter shows the pawn's temporary name, not the decorated kind label, so nothing visibly goes stale today. Anything later hooked to those notifications will see the baby without its inherited traits in this one branch, but with them in the spawned branch.

findings.title: Inherited material on a humanlike baby makes a statue-tinted baby
findings.detail: InheritTraits calls SetMaterial whenever either parent has a material, with no race filter. Before this change only animals took this path; now a titan human parent with a material gives its newborn the statue rendering. That may be intended; nothing here limits it to animals.
